description: A classroom hopping checkpoint screen, not proof of course traversal or precise command tracking.
notes: Every trial must finish without a fall and contain repeated landed hops.
The 25 mm clearance threshold matches the classroom step height; passing it does not establish obstacle traversal or clearance at the right time and position.
Walking/hopping handovers, backward/turning commands, and full course traversal need separate evaluation.
Five perturbed starts are not five independent training seeds.
